name: Charlotte
source:
A stern female knight who swore her allegiance to Aria.

A leader-like figure to the group, always troubled by the other girls' freewheeling actions.

A keen and observant person, Charlotte understands the strengths and weaknesses of each party member and is able to give out orders appropriate to the situation, displaying her talent as a commander.

While calm, collected, and able to be relied on most of the time, when Charlotte loses control of her emotions she loses sight of her surroundings, often repeating the phrase "Ugh, kill me!"
